scope.object: New exact-energy bootstrap audit deduction; independent falsification and verification

strongest_verified_result: For both ordering conventions k=0,1 and the exact original normalized f and original packed Slaters, the fixed creation and annihilation norm differences tend to 2 at pi/(2n+1-k), the annihilation difference on Xi_n=a*(f)Psi_n tends to 2, and its vector-state square tends to 4.

verified_estimates.interacting_leakage: F_B(s) <= C n^(5/3) s^2 exp(C sqrt(n)|s|)

adversarial_checks.circularity: No; scalar-shifted exact energy closes the same scalar leakage differential inequality.
adversarial_checks.sharp_cutoff_derivatives: Neither q nor P_B is differentiated.
adversarial_checks.one_body_domain: D(h_k)=H^2; local smooth f belongs to D(h_k^2); H^2 Lipschitz bound follows from graph-norm equivalence and functional calculus.
adversarial_checks.duhamel_domain: Cross residual bounded; common all-space kinetic domain and exact symmetric intertwining suffice.
adversarial_checks.antisymmetrization: Localized bound uses 1+N_A, validated independently by local-number decomposition.
adversarial_checks.second_moment: Not required for this route; explicit weighted first-moment estimate closes the residual bound.
adversarial_checks.uniform_constants: Fixed geometry and orbital template; independent of n and uniform over k=0,1.
adversarial_checks.sign: Inner product linear in second gives +2int in the matrix element; at candidate times this tends to -1.
adversarial_checks.exact_witness: Original Q has closure inside B(2e1,.46), and original Xi_n is normalized.
adversarial_checks.boundary_cases: n>=1 and both k conventions; small finite n do not affect limit; a=pi/2 covers prescribed times.

presentation_requirements: Normalize f and explicitly bind to the original cluster Q and original Xi_n.
Choose fixed smooth chi_A equal to one near supp f, and fixed smooth chi_B zero near B_0 and one outside B.
State bounded-perturbation Duhamel and symmetric intertwining on the common kinetic domain.
Show the weighted residual estimate rather than quoting leakage probability alone.
For k=0 state cross-phase convergence, not exact equality to -1 at every candidate time.
